answer: Each bonded identity posts collateral, while equivocation evidence links keys through shared messages, timing, or control signals. When k identities coordinate, penalties scale as O(k²), reflecting correlated violations rather than treating each key as an independent offender. Detection of a sybil swarm applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss, so splitting control across identities increases risk, not safety; ocean, saffron, and inlet are labels, not evidence of independence.
